statement: A byte string writing 65535 -- a value that fits in 2 bytes -- with additional-info 26 (a 4-byte argument) is not decoded
deviation: 65535's shortest form is the ai=25 form `19 ff ff`. The ai=26 form is 2 bytes longer. The scanner's judgement is `v > u16::MAX`, with 65535/65536 on either side of it.
origin: gx self-authored for the fix hand (req/38 §16 H6-4)

control.note: 65536 is the smallest value that does not fit in 2 bytes, so the ai=26 form is shortest = accepted
